policy: Rule 0 (§0a) — Opus plans, Sonnet executes; ALL reviews are Opus; the terminal AUDIT is always Opus and non-negotiable. Opus is concentrated on low-volume/high-leverage judgment; Sonnet handles high-volume bulk (execution-token-volume >> review-token-volume). Models are aliases (opus|sonnet|haiku), never pinned claude-* IDs (ai-safety-gate R3 vetoes hardcoded model literals).
